comment: E3 Round 27 — multi-space federation between two nodes. Spec authority: federation/move-anchor-replication.md. Builds on E2 (round 26) two-node real-spawn, but extends to N spaces under one federation pair. Per-space anchor isolation is the core invariant: each space has its own anchor frontier; replaying Move from server_a → server_b for space X must not affect space Y's frontier on either side.

encoder.frontier_isolation_rule: anchor frontiers are partitioned by space_id; cross-space operations are forbidden

vectors.name: multi_space_replay_three_spaces_independent_frontiers
vectors.comment: server_a hosts 3 spaces (S1, S2, S3). Each ingests one Move. server_b federates pull on each space individually. Each replay updates only the target space's frontier on server_b; the other two stay empty.

expected.rationale: Per-space anchor isolation: each pull updates exactly its target space's frontier.

vectors.name: multi_space_concurrent_move_replay
vectors.comment: Both server_a and server_b host two spaces each (S1 + S2). Both ingest Moves into S1 and S2 simultaneously. Bidirectional federation pull/push converges each space independently. After convergence, both nodes show the same frontier per space, but S1 and S2 frontiers stay distinct.

expected.rationale: After full bidirectional pull, each space converges to the same frontier on both nodes. S1 and S2 remain isolated.

vectors.name: multi_space_cross_space_move_rejected
vectors.comment: Negative — a Move payload claims to update space_S1's frontier from a federation push pulled from space_S2's anchor stream. The peer must reject with cross_space_move_forbidden.

expected.rationale: Anchor scope must equal the declared space_id; cross-space replay is forbidden.

vectors.name: multi_space_per_space_anchor_seq_independent
vectors.comment: Each space's anchor sequence number increments independently. After 3 anchors in S1 and 1 in S2, S1.seq=3 and S2.seq=1, NOT a global counter.

expected.rationale: Per-space sequence numbers — global ordering would leak cross-space activity timing.
